tools.name: AD User Lookup
tools.description: Search users in Active Directory and show their details.
tools.long_description: Searches user accounts by name, logon name or e-mail and shows status, last logon, lockout state and groups. Requires the RSAT tools for Active Directory (added automatically during installation).
tools.author: DarkMatter

de.name: AD Benutzerabfrage
de.description: Benutzer im Active Directory suchen und Details anzeigen.
de.long_description: Sucht Benutzerkonten über Name, Anmeldename oder E-Mail und zeigt Status, letzte Anmeldung, Sperrstatus und Gruppen. Benötigt die RSAT-Tools für Active Directory (werden bei der Installation automatisch hinzugefügt).

en.name: AD User Lookup
en.description: Search users in Active Directory and show their details.
en.long_description: Searches user accounts by name, logon name or e-mail and shows status, last logon, lockout state and groups. Requires the RSAT tools for Active Directory (added automatically during installation).

tools.name: IconForge
tools.description: Icons and pictograms from many free icon libraries - search, customise and export, e.g. for Visio.
tools.long_description: Searchable grid of over 100,000 icons from more than 25 free libraries (Lucide built in, Tabler, Phosphor, Material, Fluent, Font Awesome and more downloaded on demand). Shows licence and permitted uses per icon, adjusts colour, stroke width and background and exports SVG, PNG, ICO, PDF or JPG in several sizes.
tools.author: DarkMatter

de.name: IconForge
de.description: Symbole und Piktogramme aus vielen freien Bibliotheken - suchen, anpassen und exportieren, z. B. für Visio.
de.long_description: Durchsuchbares Raster mit über 100.000 Symbolen aus mehr als 25 freien Bibliotheken (Lucide eingebaut, Tabler, Phosphor, Material, Fluent, Font Awesome u. a. werden bei Bedarf geladen). Zeigt Lizenz und erlaubte Nutzung je Symbol, passt Farbe, Strichstärke und Hintergrund an und exportiert als SVG, PNG, ICO, PDF oder JPG in mehreren Größen.

en.name: IconForge
en.description: Icons and pictograms from many free icon libraries - search, customise and export, e.g. for Visio.
en.long_description: Searchable grid of over 100,000 icons from more than 25 free libraries (Lucide built in, Tabler, Phosphor, Material, Fluent, Font Awesome and more downloaded on demand). tools.name: OmniVault
tools.description: Built-in password manager plus connectors to external password managers.
tools.long_description: Manage credentials in the built-in OmniWrench password manager and connect external managers (Microsoft SecretManagement, KeePass, Netwrix Password Secure). Once connected, every credential picker in OmniWrench searches all managers at once. Passwords from external managers are only fetched when needed and kept in memory for the current session.
tools.author: DarkMatter

de.name: OmniVault
de.description: Eingebauter Passwortmanager mit Konnektoren zu externen Passwortmanagern.
de.long_description: Speichert Zugangsdaten im eingebauten OmniWrench-Passwortmanager und bindet externe Manager an (Microsoft SecretManagement, KeePass, Netwrix Password Secure). Die Zugangsdaten-Auswahl in OmniWrench durchsucht anschließend alle verbundenen Manager. Passwörter externer Manager werden bei Bedarf abgerufen und nur für die laufende Sitzung im Arbeitsspeicher gehalten.

en.name: OmniVault
en.description: Built-in password manager with connectors to external password managers.
en.long_description: Stores credentials in the built-in OmniWrench password manager and connects external managers (Microsoft SecretManagement, KeePass, Netwrix Password Secure). Credential pickers in OmniWrench then search all connected managers. Passwords from external managers are retrieved on demand and kept in memory for the current session only.

tools.name: Subnet Calculator
tools.description: Calculate IPv4/IPv6 networks and split them into subnets.
tools.long_description: Calculates network address, broadcast, netmask, wildcard, host range and number of hosts. Splits networks into equally sized subnets and exports the list as CSV.
tools.author: DarkMatter

de.name: Subnetzrechner
de.description: IPv4/IPv6-Netze berechnen und in Subnetze aufteilen.
de.long_description: Berechnet Netzadresse, Broadcast, Netzmaske, Wildcard, Hostbereich und Anzahl der Hosts. Teilt Netze in gleich große Subnetze auf und exportiert die Liste als CSV.

de_bad.name: Netzle-Rechner
de_bad.description: IPv4/IPv6-Netzle usrechne un in kleineri Stückle verteile.
de_bad.long_description: Rechnet Netzadress, Broadcast, Netzmask, Wildcard, Hostbereich un wie viel Hosts nei bassed. Verteilt Netze in gliich großi Stückle un schreibt d Lischt als CSV raus.

en.name: Subnet Calculator
en.description: Calculate IPv4/IPv6 networks and split them into subnets.
